entries.proposition: Cohort: 163 male mice considered; about 80 percent of 150 pilocarpine mice reached stage 3 or more and about 30 percent survived beyond one week; 45 epileptic mice were analysed.
entries.snippet: Of 150 pilocarpine‐injected mice, ~80% reached stage ≥3 and ~30% survived >1 week following SE termination. Thus, 45 epileptic mice were subjected to analyses.

entries.proposition: Intervention: a single intra-cisterna magna injection of 10 uL at 100 ug/mL anti-C1q or isotype IgG at day 7.
entries.snippet: C1q neutralizing antibody (100 μg/mL; GTX54404, GeneTex) or the immunoglobulin G (IgG) 2b isotype control (100 μg/mL; GTX35023, GeneTex) was infused (10 μL total) at 500 nL/min using a syringe pump.
